skills.name: Blazing Fire (梵天)
skills.line: It's your pleasure to see me enter the fray.
skills.description:
SP Shuten Douji commands a ball of flames to attack single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.
When he is in his Demoniac State, this skill changes to Torch the Sky.

skills.name: Torch the Sky (烈焰焚天/烈火梵天)
skills.description: SP Shuten Douji calls forth a huge blazing comet to smash a single target, dealing damage equal to 196% of his ATK. Also inflicts splash damage to all other enemies, dealing true damage equal to 20% of the damage received by the initial target. Splash damage won't trigger his own soul effects.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 206% and true damage increases to 25%.
Damage increases to 216% and true damage increases to 30%.
Damage increases to 226% and true damage increases to 35%.
Damage increases to 245% and true damage increases to 40%.

skills.name: Inflamed (红莲/紅蓮)
skills.line: As long as I protect Mt. Oe, I'm willing to be burnt to ashes!
skills.description:
SP Shuten Douji gains immunity to control effects and effects such as Banish. Also healing effects on him are reduced by 50%.
Grants all allies High Spirit's Force. ;High Spirit's Force (大妖の力) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Exclusive effect. Increases damage dealt by 1% per 1% of HP lost. Cannot be stacked.

upgrades.text: Increases damage reduction for all allies with High Spirit's Force by 1% per 1% of HP lost.
Effect for High Spirit's Force is doubled on himself.

skills.name: Raging Blaze (天火怒焱/天火怒炎)
skills.line: This ever-burning flame will devour my last hesitation!
skills.description:
SP Shuten Douji unleashes a powerful demoniac force and sends out a thundering roar, decreasing the move bar of all enemies by 30% and dispels 1 buff from them. Then he enters Demoniac State for 2 turns.
This skill can only be used when he is not in his Demoniac State. ;Demoniac State (鬼王の姿) : :'''General, Mark''': Sets the world ablaze. At the start of an ally's turn, 24% of their current HP is burned away and they become immune to all forms of damage for that turn. HP burning is consider as losing HP and can remove Sleep.

upgrades.text: Number of buffs dispelled increases to 2.
When Demoniac State ends, recovers all allies' HP by 20% of the damage SP Shuten Douji dealt during the state.
Decrease to move bar increases to 40%.
When an ally is burned and if their HP drops below 30%, all control effects on them are removed.

bio.condition: Team SP Shuten Douji with SP Ibaraki Douji and clear any zone 10 times.
Increase SP Shuten Douji skills 8 times.
With SP Shuten Douji win 10 times in against Ootakemaru.
